svg.style: background: #ffffff; background-color: var(--ge-adaptive-bg, #ffffff); color-scheme: light dark;
svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="0.52" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="quvf5xK9AOAOc5C2Bk81"> <mxGraphModel dx="3260" dy="1150" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="850" pageHeight="1100" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle
skinparam roundcorner 10
skinparam actorStyle awesome

' Định nghĩa màu sắc giống mẫu
skinparam rectangle {
 BackgroundColor #0288D1
 BorderColor #01579B
 FontColor White
 FontStyle bold
}
skinparam usecase {
 BackgroundColor White
 BorderColor #0277BD
}

actor \"Account\" as BaseUser
actor \"Merchant Owner\" as Owner
actor \"Merchant Staff\" as Staff
actor \"Client System / SDK\" as Client
actor \"Administrator\" as Admin
actor \"AI Agent (MCP)\" as AI
actor \"Sui Testnet\" as Sui

' Kế thừa Actor
Owner --|> BaseUser
Staff --|> BaseUser
Admin --|> BaseUser

rectangle \"OctaPoint Platform\" {
 ' Common
 usecase \"UC-01: Log in / Log out\" as UC_Login
 usecase \"UC-02: Manage Account Profile\" as UC_Profile
 usecase \"UC-18: Register Merchant Account\" as UC_Register
 
 ' Admin
 usecase \"UC-03: View Admin Dashboard\" as UC_AdminDash
 usecase \"UC-04: Approve / Suspend Merchant\" as UC_Approve
 
 ' Merchant Owner
 usecase \"UC-05: View Merchant Dashboard\" as UC_OwnerDash
 usecase \"UC-06: Configure Loyalty Rules\" as UC_Rules
 usecase \"UC-07: Manage API Credentials\" as UC_ApiKeys
 usecase \"UC-08: Manage Merchant Staff\" as UC_Staff
 usecase \"UC-14: Create Reversal Transaction\" as UC_Reversal
 
 ' Core Points
 usecase \"UC-09: Manage Customer Profiles\" as UC_Customer
 usecase \"UC-10: Issue Points\" as UC_Issue
 usecase \"UC-11: Redeem Points\" as UC_Redeem
 usecase \"UC-12: Check Customer Balance\" as UC_Balance
 usecase \"UC-13: View Transaction Ledger\" as UC_Ledger
 
 ' Security & Integrations
 usecase \"UC-15: Verify HMAC & Timestamp\" as UC_HMAC
 usecase \"UC-16: Anchor Proof on Sui\" as UC_Anchor
 usecase \"UC-17: Query Credit via MCP\" as UC_MCP
}

' Liên kết Account
BaseUser --> UC_Login
BaseUser --> UC_Profile

' Liên kết Admin
Admin --> UC_AdminDash
Admin --> UC_Approve
Admin --> UC_Ledger

' Liên kết Owner
Owner --> UC_OwnerDash
Owner --> UC_Rules
Owner --> UC_ApiKeys
Owner --> UC_Staff
Owner --> UC_Customer
Owner --> UC_Ledger
Owner --> UC_Reversal

' Liên kết Staff
Staff --> UC_Customer
Staff --> UC_Issue
Staff --> UC_Redeem
Staff --> UC_Balance
Staff --> UC_Ledger

' Liên kết Client System / SDK
Client --> UC_Issue
Client --> UC_Redeem
Client --> UC_Balance

' Liên kết AI Agent
AI --> UC_MCP

' Quan hệ Include & Trigger
UC_Issue ..> UC_HMAC : <<include>>
UC_Redeem ..> UC_HMAC : <<include>>
UC_Issue ..> UC_Anchor : <<trigger>>
UC_Redeem ..> UC_Anchor : <<trigger>>
UC_Anchor --> Sui

@enduml",
